tools.name: havalimani_bul
tools.description: Look up IATA airport codes by city or airport name (Turkish or English). Use this before ucus_ara when the user gives a city name instead of a 3-letter code.

tools.name: ucus_ara
tools.description: Search scheduled flight options between two airports on a date for a group trip, optionally including nearby airports. Returns airlines, flight numbers, times, duration and stops. Does not return prices; group fares are quoted by GrupTalepleri.com after a group request.

tools.name: duyuru_rehber_ara
tools.description: Search GrupTalepleri.com announcements (airline news, strikes, new routes, events) and destination travel guides by keyword. Returns titles and links.

tools.name: grup_talebi_olustur
tools.description: Creates a group flight request for GrupTalepleri.com from the route, date and passenger count, plus the contact person's name, phone number and email address. The GrupTalepleri.com team handles the request and contacts the user; this does not automatically create an account or send a message. Before

tools.name: ozel_ucus_talebi
tools.description: Creates a private jet, helicopter or charter aircraft request for GrupTalepleri.com (1 to 400 passengers) with route, date, passenger count and the contact person's name, phone and email. Use havalimani_bul first to get IATA codes. The GrupTalepleri.com team handles the request and contacts the user

tools.name: talep_durumu
tools.description: Returns the current status of a GrupTalepleri.com group flight request. Requires both the request number (e.g. UG-XXXXXX) and the phone number used in that request. Returns route, dates, passenger count and a status sentence; prices are not returned.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "grup_talebi_olustur" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: grup_talebi_olustur, ozel_ucus_talebi · Private data: grup_talebi_olustur, ozel_ucus_talebi · Public sink: grup_talebi_olustur, ozel_ucus_talebi.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: grup_talebi_olustur, ozel_ucus_talebi · Private data: grup_talebi_olustur, ozel_ucus_talebi · Public sink: grup_talebi_olustur, ozel_ucus_talebi

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
